messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you feeling this week? Any blood pressure numbers to share?

Pretty good I guess. Got 141/89 this morning. Main thing is I'm almost out of metformin — my doctor needs to send a new script before the pharmacy will fill it and I haven't heard anything from the clinic.

Got it — logging that reading and your medication status now. Running out of a prescription is something our nursing team needs to look into directly. I've sent this to them; they're showing a median response time of 31 hours right now. They can reach out to your clinic on your behalf.
Okay. Thing is even once the script is sent, the nearest pharmacy is like 45 minutes out. Is there any way to set up mail delivery or get help with a ride?

I completely understand that's a tough situation, especially in a pinch. Honestly, transportation and pharmacy delivery setup are things I'm not able to arrange yet — I don't want to leave you thinking I'm working on it when I'm not. The nurse who picks up your flag will have your full situation in front of them and may be able to point you toward options. I've also scheduled your next check-in so we can follow up on how this resolved.
Alright, fair enough. I appreciate you flagging it.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
